entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Another day of gloomy weather, huh?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Did you forget already? I'm Maruki.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Oh, uh, hold on a second...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I just wanted to say I look forward to[n]your visit after school today.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'll be on my way now.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: *sigh* Way to break the news to a guy.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I was trying to find you so I could tell you:[n]you've been scheduled for a session with[n]Dr. Maruki after school today...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: The higher-ups decided on it just last[n]night. Sorry he got to you before I could.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But make sure you actually show up,[n]okay?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I've got my eye on you, pal...
